chunks: (God) said: "This is right by Me, and what I say is right."
ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'Al-Haqq wa al-Haqq aqulu' mean in Surah Sad?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this declaration underscores the absolute sovereignty of God in distinguishing truth from falsehood, often linked to the authenticity of the Prophet's message and the Imams' teachings. It serves as a foundational principle for validating divine revelation against human claims, affirming that God's word is the ultimate criterion (al-Haqq) in matters of faith and jurisprudence.
